name: The Forgotten

passive_description.localized: Increases ATK by <lv>{0}</> when the wearer’s HP is above 50%; increases DEF by <lv>{1}</> when HP is below 50%.
passive_description.source: 装备者生命值高于50%的时候攻击力提高<lv>{0}</>；生命值低于50%的时候，防御力提高<lv>{1}</>。

tested_hypotheses: The wearer's current HP is sampled immediately before each delivered hit, including delayed and off-field hits.
ATK applies additively to base ATK and DEF to native base DEF; equality applies neither modifier.
DEF-scaled packets require native base-DEF provenance; this does not model enemy incoming damage mitigation.
